            )

                or re.fullmatch(r"[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]?\s*\d[A-Z]{2}", clean, re.I)

        def is_country_only(text: str) -> bool:

                    parts = parts[:idx] + parts[idx + 1 :] + [parts[idx]]
